notes.title: Update 4
notes.notes:
Mellow greetings Comrades,

Before starting we want to apologize for the long wait. And we want to clarify at the same time that NO, the project is not dead nor abandoned. As in the beginning, we are just as convinced that we can make an great game, with more to it than meets the eye.

2017 has been a very tough winter for the whole team, which began in a phased manner at the beginning of the year and resulted in a sudden blow after our last update (Update 3) in mid-May, which dragged the studio and the project. We are not going to lie, we could have communicated more, but to the economic problems that started in January, due to non-payments of external works whose objective was to finance the project (cash for rent and food), the problems at our homes derived from 6 months without receiving a salary were added, and especially from June to November, we have focused more on rescuing a little our families and our lives and little by little relaunch the study and the project of the situation in which everything was sunk.

We would like to have kept updates more constant even if they were more reduced, but the problems escalation was not the only handicap, since this update includes changes in the game's central mechanics, which have resulted in a rather slower publication than we would have liked. However, we believe we owe each of you our most sincere apologies.

As a result, you will see that this new version has little to do with the previous one, and develops a new mode of history designed with unique and appealing characters, which will help us to become more involved in the experience that unfolds in the game world. Still has bugs and narrative issues of course, but we are back on fight! =D

Please feel free to share your issues, recommendations and feedback on the forums, or directly @Beardserk on Twitter.

Thanks for your support and Happy New Year!

Love is in the hair,
the Beardserk team.

ChangeLog:

ADDED: A new story mode.
ADDED: The game is now organized in chapters, days and events of the day.
ADDED: New recognizable characters.
ADDED: More interaction with dissidence.
ADDED: Added goal mechanics to meet before the end of the day.
ADDED: Start of generic interrogatories to unchain specific confessions, clues and secrets.
ADDED: An interrogatory can influence another interrogatory.
ADDED: You can interrogate a person several times.
ADDED: The interrogations can be repeated.
ADDED: Included the filing cabinet sound that was missing
ADDED: Added a clock to the map to clear the desktop.
ADDED: Intro can be skipped.
ADDED: Extended suspects profile, with tabs and more information.
ADDED: Added special story scenes.
ADDED: Support for different Endings.
ADDED: New, more readable fonts.
ADDED: Case "ROBIN HOOD".
ADDED: Case "JEWELRY SHOP".
ADDED: Case "BAD DRUGS".
ADDED: Case "FACTORY FIRE".
ADDED: Case "GARDENER CALL".
ADDED: Several generic incidents.
ADDED: Possibility of losing either by a trap or lack of compliance with obligations.
ADDED: Possibility of modifying reality and imprisoning or releasing at will, as long as the ministry is kept out of suspicion.
ADDED: New documents, packages and letters with which to interact.
ADDED: We have an assistant at our disposal.
UPDATED: Balanced the difficulty in the incident map.
UPDATED: Stabilization improvement in interrogations.
UPDATED: Interrogatories are now more fluid, improved navigation.
UPDATED: Improved font size for better reading.
UPDATED: The interrogatory avatar is better positioned.
UPDATED: We support a greater number of game characters.
UPDATED: The interrogation room has more details and objects.
UPDATED: Avatars of suspects have more detail.
UPDATED: Slight color changes in UI.
UPDATED: Improvement in document management and UI depth.
UPDATED: Improved the tutorial, adding highlighting and more interaction.
UPDATED: Now the game is saved by completed days not actions.
UPDATED: Improved the tutorial, adding highlighting and more interaction.
UPDATED: Rewritten all generic cases.
FIXED: With the map open if an incident is launched the map is refreshed.
FIXED: If an Agent returns from an incident, it disappears from the map.
FIXED: If you kill a suspect he will not appear again in the game.
FIXED: Reduced the volume of in-game music.


Since mechanics are pretty much rounding up, in upcoming updates we will focus on keep adding content to fill out the different game chapters as well as polishing the mechanics we already have at the moment.

notes.title: Update 3
notes.notes:
Mellow greetings Comrades

As always, thanks to all for your comments and feedback, is really helping us a lot to improve and little by little give shape to the game.

After some internal updates in the Steam development branch, we are bringing the 3rd update. This time, focusing in the Map experience where the icons will explain a bit better which officer skill is mainly required to be used, as well as incident extra information to help you take some decisions. The incidents still need some work to be balanced and adapting to game progressive difficulty, as well as story, but now you will be able to get more the feeling of how they will look like.

As in previous updates, we have solve some typos and stability issues. For the next update we want to bring finally some storyline in form of the first chapter of the game plot, and meet with some of the main characters that will step in your way during these days of confusion and despair in Roulettenburg.

Please feel free to share your issues, recommendations and feedback on the forums, or directly @Beardserk on Twitter.

Thanks for your support!

Love is in the hair,
the Beardserk team.

notes.title: Update 2
notes.notes:
Mellow greetings Comrades,

We have take a bit more time than we wanted to get you the second update, since we got an internal update in between that was not totally convincing us. But here it comes!

We have mainly fixed bugs related to wrong game states, generic interrogations being used when conditions where not matching and provoking inconsistent results, and of course misspellings and typos (those lovely friends of us).

We have change the dialog and intercom, to not auto continue the messages, so now you can take as much time as you want to read them, and click to continue.

For the ones of you who want to be curious of what is being worked on, and are not afraid inconsistency, you can check out the development branch on the Steam client (upcoming guide for those of you who don't know how to is getting baked). This is the branch we use for test our builds, and is totally free to access for the users that own the game, but we cant offer support there, so please before reporting a bug ensure you are playing the default branch. We are testing there also MAC builds, but we don't want to officially release the support on them until we go to a further phase, since we want to be really focused on the game content.

Please feel free to share your issues and feedback on the forums, or directly @Beardserk on Twitter.

Thanks for your support!

Love is in the hair,
the Beardserk team.

Changelog:


    ADDED: Now you need to click to continue any dialogue. You can also click to skip the typewriting effect.
    ADDED: Now variables from cases and incidents has been separated to avoid cross-data issues.
    ADDED: New case orders has been added, since in some cases generic orders were being used and they were not meant to all types of cases. This will also accommodate a bit the difficulty.
    ADDED: Now sentences archive can be opened and closed, as the tutorial mention.
    UPDATED: Text on dialogues is now align to left to make easier the reading while typewriting is active.
    UPDATED: Text on dialogues has been transformed to a gender neutral language.
    UPDATED: Several interrogations to improve consistency.
    UPDATED: Improved feedback from intercom.
    UPDATED: Sentences and orders now are consistent on name and description.
    UPDATED: Now some splash screens can be skipped.
    UPDATED:  Number of incidents on the city is more controlled during tutorial. Thanks to Dron
    FIXED: Now starting a new game doesn't generate a corrupted state on the game. So there is no need to restart the game. Thanks to Dron and @peterWallet
    FIXED: Clicking on the portrait of the office was provoking a fade to black.
    FIXED: Several issues while upgrading officer level on tutorial. Thanks to Dron and to Erin
    FIXED: Some dialogue entries where not directing to the use of force even if they were meant to.
    FIXED: Stamp anywhere was sometimes returning to main menu.
    FIXED: Several issues while signing.
    FIXED: Now some metadata, like “[suspect_address_list]” or others, is not showing on the text. Thanks to Sir Miller Berto
    FIXED: Black screen during torture was sometimes breaking the dialog and throwing you back to the desktop. Thanks to bazackward
    FIXED: Character portraits where appearing broken on some screens resolutions.
    FIXED: Several English localization issues. Thanks to ROFL MAO

notes.title: Update 1
notes.notes:
Mellow greetings Comrades,

First of all thanks to all of you for the warm welcome, the support, and the constructive feedback from the very beginning!

We are really thankful for the positive feedback, even on the current alfa status of the game. We are aware that content is limited and issues can be quite frustrating, but we wanted to start having early feedback because the game need to feels good and its mechanics reasonable before we even start polishing, and that is something we wanted to do with the community.

We've just uploaded a first update fixing some of those annoying bugs that were provoking the interrogatories to sometimes finish suddenly. This is caused when the dialog line doesn't have associated a following line, and is neither marked as ending, so a little bit of patience while we can spot them all and fix them, because there is a lot of dialog ;)

We've also fixed some of the reported typos and text issues, hopefully we don't miss much here, but anything that you might find, please report it on the forum because that is something we can fix quite quickly. For next update, we are thinking to add a sort of toggle debug view, where you can see extra info of the displayed text and current game status, in an effort to make easier for you too to describe those errors.

Please feel free to share your issues and feedback on the forums, or directly  @Beardserk on Twitter.

Thanks for your support and for keep believing in the project!

Love is in the hair,
the Beardserk team.

ADDED: Now we explain the interrogations and how not everything you are told has to be true
UPDATED: Improved consistency of the tutorial arrows to disappear.
FIXED: Interrogatories that went out to the desktop. Thanks to Dron
FIXED: A series of questions that had no answer in Database
FIXED: Double links between dialogs have been resolved
